text: Stopped pushing 9 m short of 0.2 to patch router (the prompt said Hold E to patch). Boulder rolled back down the slope out of reach while E was held; next release went 9 m -> 28 m. No warning that patching on the slope lets it roll.

Rolled boulder back from uphill (good 'Rolling it back to turn it' prompt), storage came under crosshair, held E ~5s: storage 64% -> healthy 100%. Holding E past completion starts a new 'Patching [#....]' bar on the now-healthy module. Also the world-space '0.1' terrace sign label draws on top of the HUD issue percentages.

After releasing E (patch completed on storage), the prompt keeps showing 'Patching [#..........]' under 'storage: healthy (100%)' for 3+ s of game time with no key held; it looks like a patch is still running.

Pushed uphill with hold w 15 from just below the boulder; partway the boulder slid off to the side and rolled back to the 0.1 terrace while Sisyphus kept walking up the hill alone. No cue that contact was lost; I only found out by turning around.

Second and third attempts to push from the 0.1 terrace toward 0.2: lined up on the trail centre with the boulder just ahead, hold w 5/6; the boulder escaped within ~2 m each time and rolled back to the 0.1 terrace (distance stays 27-29 m). First ascent (0.0 to 0.1) had no such trouble. Hard to tell what I do wrong; no on-screen cue about contact or alignment.

Held R on 'auth: rotting (85%)' ~4.5 s: auth retired (Modules 7->6, Users 50->46, nice 'Retired. One less thing to keep, and a few users miss it.'). But after it the prompt shows 'router: healthy (92%)' with a half-full 'Retiring [######.....]' bar that stays after R is released, as if the healthy router is being retired. Router was NOT retired. Same stale bar as the patch prompt.

HUD lists 'parser deprecated API' as the open issue (now 19%) but nothing on the boulder or HUD says WHERE parser is on the boulder. I rolled the boulder ~3 m back from above in 0.4 s steps reading the crosshair prompt: saw core, parser (briefly, then passed it), router, auth, search, ui... ui stayed on top for 6+ nudges because rolling straight keeps one great circle. ~10 minutes of hunting and parser still unpatched at 19%. No marker/colour on the rotting face.

Pushing the boulder sideways along the terrace (from its side, not from above) turned a different axis and brought parser into reach at once; held E 5 s: parser 17% -> 100%, 'No open issues. It will not last.' Turning by side-pushing works but nothing in-game teaches it.
